zh.text: 工資支付方法

en.text: Private tuition is usually paid for by time rates because

zh.text: 私家補習一般是依照「計時」方式支付報酬的。這是因為

en.text: the incentive to work is stronger.

zh.text: 這種計酬方法可以提高工作熱誠。
這種計酬方法可以保證有更佳的考試成績。
補習費用可以較低。

en.text: The output is difficult to measure.

zh.text: 這種工作的產出量難以量度。
香港中學會考 1991 卷二 第 8 題

en.text: Instead of receiving only a fixed monthly salary, hotel waiters in Hong Kong generally earn a low basic monthly salary and receive tips from customers. To the hotel owners, which of the following in an advantage of the latter method of payment compared to the former method?

zh.text: 香港的酒店侍應一般都不是只收取固定月薪，而是在低廉的基本工資上再加上客人給予的小費。對酒店東主來說，後一種支酬方法較前一種為優之處是

en.text: It is easier to calculate the output of the waiters.

zh.text: 更容易計算侍應的產出。
所需侍應數目較少。

en.text: There is a better relationship among the waiters.

zh.text: 各侍應間關係更好。
侍應提供更佳服務。
香港中學會考 1994 卷二 第 18 題

en.text: Secondary school teachers in Hong Kong are in general paid by time rates because

zh.text: 香港的中學教師一般都是以「時計方式」計酬的，因為

en.text: the tasks of a teacher are not standardized.

zh.text: 教師擔當多種不同性質的工作。

en.text: the output cannot be easily measured.

zh.text: 教師的產出不易量度。

en.text: there is a higher incentive to work.

zh.text: 這可以提高工作的積極性。
香港中學會考 1995 卷二 第 17 題

en.text: An employer has changed the method of payment to his employees and observed the following results:

zh.text: 某僱主改變了他對僱員的付薪方法，觀察得下列結果：
舊方法
新方法
每工人每天的產出數量
水準以下的產品數目

zh.text: 舊方法極可能是__________而新方法極可能是__________。
時計……件計
件計……時計

en.text: Private piano teachers are usually paid at an hourly rate instead of a piece rate. Which of the following statements are true?

zh.text: 私人鋼琴教師的酬勞一般都是「以時計薪」而非「以件計酬」。下列哪幾項是正確的？

en.text: They tend to work longer hours.

zh.text: 他們傾向工作更長時間。

en.text: They are not encouraged to rush through more music pieces in a lesson.

zh.text: 僱主不鼓勵他們每課倉猝地教授更多樂章。

en.text: Their output is difficult to measure.

zh.text: 他們的產出不易量度。

第二級 ……「件計」

第三級 ……「件計」

zh.text: 假設部分公務員的支薪方式由「時計」改變「件計」。這種改變 不會 使
他們的收入增加。

zh.text: 他們的工作質素改善。

en.text: an increase in the monitoring and supervision cost of their work.

zh.text: 監督他們工作的成本上升。

en.text: an increase in the quantity of work completed by them.

zh.text: 他們完成的工作數量更多。

zh.text: 參閱以下的招聘職員廣告：

zh.text: XYZ 公司量度薪酬支出的成本較高。

en.text: The working incentive of mail assistants is higher in the XYZ Company.

zh.text: XYZ 公司信差的工作熱誠較高。

en.text: The income of a mail assistant is higher in the ABC Company.

zh.text: ABC 公司信差的收入較高。

en.text: The cost of supervision is lower in the ABC Company.

zh.text: ABC 公司監察信差的成本較低。

en.text: Inside a firm, paying workers by the hour is chosen because

zh.text: 在廠商內部，選擇按時支薪予工人是因為
工人並不誠實。

en.text: workers have different levels of productivity.

zh.text: 工人有不同的生產力水平。

en.text: the activities performed by workers are not easily standardized.

zh.text: 工人所執行的工作不易標準化。
監管成本低。

en.text: Under the previous wage payment system, Mrs Chan found that her workers were lazy. Now, she has adopted another wage payment system under which the quantity as well as the quality of the output of her firm has been raised. This improvement could be due to the fact that the previous wage payment system was ______ and the present one is ______.

zh.text: 陳太發現她的員工在舊有的薪酬制度下是懶惰的。現在，她採用另一套薪酬制度，因而公司的產出無論量或質都有所改善。這可能是因爲舊薪酬制度是______而新薪酬制度是______。

件計 ... 利潤分享
時計 ... 件計
時計 ... 利潤分享

en.text: A factory owner has changed the method of payment to his workers and observes a higher labour productivity of his workers, but a lower quality of output. Most probably the old payment system is _______ and the new payment system is _______.

zh.text: 某工廠東主發現在他改變支付員工薪酬的方式後，員工生產力提高，但產品質素下降。舊的薪酬方式最有可能是_________而新的薪酬方式最有可能是_________。
時間薪酬 ... 件工
件工 ... 時間薪酬
利潤分享制 ... 時間薪酬
件工 ... 利潤分享制

en.text: Whose employer would have the highest cost in monitoring the performance of his work?

zh.text: 在下列人士中，誰的僱主要付出最高成本以監察其工作表現？

en.text: an office clerk who is paid with a fixed monthly salary

zh.text: 一位辦公室文員，他收取固定月薪作爲報酬。

en.text: a property agent who is paid through commission

zh.text: 一位地產經紀，他收取佣金作爲報酬。

en.text: a tourist guide who is paid with tips

zh.text: 一位導遊，他收取小費作爲報酬。

en.text: a movie star who shares the profit with his film producer

zh.text: 一位明星，他與製片公司分享利潤作爲報酬。

en.text: In Hong Kong, taxi fares are charged by the mile plus waiting time during traffic congestion. In some towns on the mainland, the taxi fare is charged by the mile only. Which of the following implications for mainland drivers is correct?

zh.text: 在香港，的士收費是按行車里程加上交通擠塞時的等候時間計算。在內地一些城鎮，的士收費只按行車里程計算。下列哪項關於內地司機的推論是正確的？

en.text: Taxi drivers in these towns tend to drive faster.

zh.text: 這些城鎮的的士司機傾向開車較快。

en.text: Taxi drivers in these towns tend to use longer routes.

zh.text: 這些城鎮的的士司機傾向選用較長的路線。

en.text: Taxi drivers in these towns tend to avoid routes with traffic congestion.

zh.text: 這些城鎮的的士司機傾向避開交通擠塞的路線。
以上皆是

zh.text: 這可提高員工的工作意欲。

zh.text: 這可將部分經營風險轉嫁給員工。

zh.text: 每月薪金： HK$12 000
達標花紅：當達成銷售目標，會發放花紅。

zh.text: 從該店的角度看，下列哪些是採用上述安排而非只以時計薪的可能原因？

en.text: The salespersons' productivity will be higher.

zh.text: 售貨員的生產力會較高。

en.text: The cost of monitoring service quality will be lower.

zh.text: 監察服務質素的成本會較低。
